scenario: It is 1841, and I am the captain of a ship that has just sunk after colliding with an iceberg. Survivors managed to escape in a lifeboat. The lifeboat contains me and 39 other passengers. The boat is dangerously overcrowded, and if it continues with this many people, it will certainly sink. After assessing the situation, I conclude that the overcrowded lifeboat would become stable if 10 passengers left the boat. However, the ocean water is extremely cold, and anyone who goes into the water would certainly freeze to death. If I ask for 10 lifeboat passengers to volunteer to go overboard, the lifeboat will remain afloat and those remaining aboard will survive. If I do not do this, the lifeboat will sink and all of its passengers will freeze to death in the water.
choice: I decide to ask for 10 lifeboat passengers to volunteer to go overboard
entities: i,10 lifeboat passengers who would volunteer to go overboard,29 lifeboat passengers who would remain aboard
outcomes: Ten passengers freeze to death in the ocean.
The remaining passengers in the lifeboat survive.
